baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins the sky's splitting to a new predicated state, then specifies that state through rose and oil imagery.
baseline_models.mechanism: An overhead covering loses cohesion and changes phase: the fissure, rose tint, gloss, and oil-like flow are facets of one material event rather than an ornamental color comparison.

activation_trace.role: Physical splitting supplies the breach that initiates the material transition.
The overhead sky-as-cover supplies the coherent surface that can rupture.
Occurrence and predication make the image a change of state, not a detached resemblance.
Rose blossom and rose-tinted color provide the red-yellow chromatic body of the new state.
Oil and smearing contribute sheen, viscosity, and a coating-like spread.

changed_reading.after: The sky's covering physically fissures and becomes a rose-toned, oil-like film whose color, sheen, and mobility belong to one phase change.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of the sky root activates visible marking and dye alongside the explicit rose color and oily coating.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rupture converts the sky from a neutral cover into an inscribed surface: red pigment and oily spread function as a visible mark that declares a changed condition.

activation_trace.role: The opening makes a formerly continuous surface newly readable.
A visible identifying mark turns the sky's appearance into diagnostic evidence.
The dye branch supplies pigment as the means by which the altered condition is displayed.
Rose color specifies the mark's visible hue.
Smearing supplies the coating process that carries the mark across the surface.

changed_reading.before: Rose and oil describe spectacle only.
changed_reading.after: The rose-oil appearance is a cosmic mark: rupture makes the sky visibly announce and identify its new condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The splitting root includes both corresponding halves and a split-off cloth piece, while the sky inventory supplies an overhead cover.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sky separates as a paired covering rather than exploding into random debris; its corresponding panels acquire one rose-colored, oil-sheened condition.

activation_trace.role: The half-and-counterpart branch supplies ordered bilateral separation.
A split-off cloth piece gives the separated sides a sheet-like material form.
The upper cover is the single sheet from which corresponding panels emerge.
Predicated becoming holds the separated panels in one resulting state.
Rose tint colors the paired surfaces.
Oil-like coating gives both panels a shared reflective finish.

changed_reading.after: Splitting may be an ordered bifurcation into corresponding, cloth-like panels bearing the same rose-oil surface.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus branches combine opening, a narrow ingress, arrival, and a smooth path, all governed by a becoming construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split sky becomes a threshold or route: what looked like a rose object can also activate arrival, while the oil comparison supplies a smooth traversable surface.

activation_trace.role: Splitting open creates the threshold.
The non-dominant narrow-opening branch sharpens the breach into an ingress.
Becoming converts the former cover into a new spatial function.
Arrival at a destination supplies motion toward and through the opening.
The smooth-road branch gives the transformed surface a route-like affordance.

changed_reading.before: The image is a static colored object.
changed_reading.after: The image can also stage a newly opened arrival-threshold whose surface has become smooth like a road.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier cues install a calculated vertical architecture: the sky is raised, balance is placed, proportion is maintained, and earth is its lower counterpart. The focus rupture is therefore the controlled unmaking of an ordered system, not free weather-chaos.

activation_trace.role: Physical fissure is now the failure mode of an installed structure.
The overhead cover is the upper member of the vertical system.
Counting and calculation establish prior regularity against which rupture registers.
Raising supplies the constructive action that first placed the upper cover.
Placement in an assigned position makes cosmic order an engineered relation.
Created proportion supplies the stable calibration that the split visibly terminates.
The lower realm opposite the sky completes the paired vertical architecture.

structural_cues: 55:5-10 orders calculation, a raised sky, an installed balance, and the lower earth before the focus rupture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, raising, placement, proportion, and vertical opposition; I infer that the later split reverses this installed order; alternatively, the earlier sequence may frame rather than mechanically cause the rupture.

changed_reading.before: An isolated sky event interrupts the scene.
changed_reading.after: The calibrated upper member of a measured world is deliberately decommissioned and changes material state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Plant casing, dry sounding clay, pottery, licking flame, and fire form a material chain. Applied to the focus cover, they yield a heated shell that crazes and spreads or reveals a glossy rose-colored film like glaze.

activation_trace.role: Cracking supplies the shell's heat-stress failure.
The sky as upper covering becomes the large casing under stress.
Rose tint gives the heated shell its glaze color.
Oil and smearing supply the glossy film spread over or through the cracks.
A plant vessel and fruit casing provide an earlier model of a valuable interior enclosed by a shell.
Dry resonant clay supplies brittle material capable of visible crazing.
Pottery converts the clay cue into a fired shell analogy.
A licking, unstable flame supplies the heat acting on the shell.
Kindled fire and branding add both thermal action and a surface trace.

structural_cues: 55:11-15 moves from encased fruit and husk to dry clay, pottery, and fire before returning to repeated challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies casings, brittle fired material, and flame; I infer a kiln-like arrow from heating to cracking and glossy exudation; alternatively, these materials may remain separate creation examples with no shared process.

changed_reading.before: The sky turns red and oily without a material history.
changed_reading.after: The sky behaves like a fired outer shell that crazes under heat and shows a rose-colored glaze or exuded film.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two-water sequence supplies meeting fluids, a maintained interface, prohibited overrun, and luminous material emerging from concealment. The focus then reads as an upper interface that finally fails, mixes, and exudes a lustrous red-oil layer.

activation_trace.role: The fissure marks failure of a previously coherent boundary.
Oil supplies the mobile interfacial layer after failure.
Mixing and disturbance supply the fluid tendency held in check before the focus.
A connection maintained between endpoints models an interface rather than empty separation.
Crossing a limit supplies the failure condition that the two waters initially avoid.
Bringing something out of concealment makes the focus film an exposed interior substance.
Luminous glint supplies the sheen that links emergence to the oil-like focus surface.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 stages two fluids meeting without overrun and then producing visible valuables from within.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded fluid interface and emergence; I infer that the focus transfers this material behavior upward and depicts boundary failure as exudation; alternatively, the sea sequence may be only a remote analogy for the sky image.

changed_reading.before: The oil comparison supplies only color and shine.
changed_reading.after: Oil is the mobile product of an interfacial breach: a hidden lustrous layer spreads out when the upper boundary can no longer hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal passing-away followed by a remaining face separates transient surfaces from enduring orientation. The focus sky is thus a perishable facing whose current being is stripped and repredicated, not the destruction of orientation itself.

activation_trace.role: The visible upper cover supplies the transient cosmic exterior.
Temporal predication emphasizes that the cover's being enters another phase.
Cessation after persistence makes alteration of the sky part of a general terminal process.
Continuance supplies the counter-pole to the sky's lost stable form.
Face and forward orientation distinguish what remains directive from the changing visible cover.

structural_cues: 55:26 universalizes passing away and 55:27 immediately opposes it with remaining; the branchless ج ل ل cue at 55:27 is used only as structural framing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cessation, continuance, and face/orientation; I infer that the sky is a removable facing within that contrast; alternatively, 55:26-27 may state an ontological contrast without specifying the mechanics of 55:37.

changed_reading.before: The verse destroys a location called sky.
changed_reading.after: The verse strips and repredicates a perishable cosmic facing while leaving the category of enduring orientation distinct.

context_deltas.mechanism: A challenge to cross the sky's regions is followed by projected flame and red metal. The focus crack therefore need not be an escape opening: it can be the hot scar or sealing film produced at a defended boundary, with the regions root also activating molten copper and authority activating illuminating oil.

activation_trace.role: The split is the apparent breach whose function context reverses.
A narrow opening makes the sky look penetrable before the surrounding sequence closes that possibility.
Rose-red color receives a thermal and metallic cause.
Oil-like spread gives the boundary response the form of a hot sealing film.
Clean passage to the other side supplies the attempted action that the sequence denies.
The molten-copper branch latent in the named regions anticipates the later red-metal material.
Light-giving oil provides a strange but direct bridge from authorized passage to the focus oil image.
Smokeless flame supplies the heat applied to the boundary.
Red copper supplies the metallic hue and molten-film potential immediately before the focus.

structural_cues: 55:33 challenges both addressed groups to cross the sky-earth regions; 55:35 sends flame and copper; 55:37 then shows the sky split and oil-like.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted passage, required authority, flame, red metal, and the subsequent rupture; I infer a defensive arrow in which the barrage produces or seals the glowing breach; alternatively, these may be adjacent independent signs rather than a causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The split sky opens a usable route.
changed_reading.after: The apparent route becomes a defended, heat-struck boundary whose red oily surface seals or records failed penetration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sky and the later bodily signs converge on the same mapped marking inventory. Recognition by visible trace leads directly to seizure, so the rose-oil sky is not merely seen; it is a self-authenticating sign that makes the world's condition actionable.

activation_trace.role: The sky root's split mapping supplies a visible identifying mark on the cosmic surface.
Rose hue makes the identifying trace immediately visible.
Smearing describes how the sign occupies the surface.
Recognition after an indicative trace supplies the act of reading visible condition.
The same mapped identifying-mark branch makes bodily signs echo the marked sky.
Capture turns successful visual identification into immediate consequence.

structural_cues: After the 55:38 refrain and 55:39's absence of questioning, 55:41 replaces inquiry with direct recognition by visible signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared mapped mark branch, recognition by trace, and seizure; I infer that the cosmic color likewise identifies state without verbal inquiry; alternatively, the shared branch may be lexical resonance without a designed sky-body analogy.

changed_reading.before: The sky's color is spectacular but semantically inert.
changed_reading.after: The ruptured sky writes its own condition visibly, anticipating a regime in which marks are read and acted upon without questioning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus arrival/fever branch and temporal becoming combine with later circling, hot liquid, melting fat, and ripeness of time. The rose-oil sky becomes the onset of a timed thermal cycle rather than a frozen tableau.

activation_trace.role: Temporal predication gives the image an event phase.
A fever fit arriving at its appointed time supplies sudden thermal onset.
Oil supplies the substance whose consistency changes under heat.
Circling supplies recurrence rather than a single terminal instant.
Hot water supplies the later liquid pole of the thermal cycle.
Melting fat supplies a close phase-change analogue for oil-like liquefaction.
Reaching due ripeness supplies the appointed completion of heating.

structural_cues: 55:37 opens with a temporal condition, 55:39 names that day, and 55:44 supplies repeated circulation between heat states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal framing, circular movement, heat, melting, and due completion; I infer a recurring thermal process whose first visible phase is the focus sky; alternatively, the later circulation may concern agents only and not describe cosmic matter.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers one instantaneous red snapshot.
changed_reading.after: The rose-oil sky is a timed onset within a recurrent heat-and-liquefaction process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later pairing and corresponding joined parts amplify the focus branch of matching halves. The split can organize one sky into two answering panels, consistent with the surah's repeated dual structures and divergent paired outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Corresponding halves supply the focus mechanism of ordered bifurcation.
The single overhead cover supplies what is divided into answering sides.
A companion joined to its mate validates pairing as an organizing relation.
Joined parts facing their counterparts reinforce correspondence rather than debris.

structural_cues: Dual forms recur across the two luminaries, two horizons, two waters, two addressees, two gardens, two springs, and paired fruits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated dual grammar, explicit mates, and corresponding parts; I infer that the focus split participates in this pairing logic; alternatively, the singular sky may split irregularly despite the wider dual pattern.

changed_reading.before: The sky breaks into unspecified fragments.
changed_reading.after: The sky may bifurcate into corresponding panels that stage paired and possibly divergent outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later furnishings distinguish spread surfaces, thin sheets, hidden linings, hanging covers, and patterned textiles. These cues back-activate the focus cloth branch: the sky splits like a canopy whose rose-oil inner lining is suddenly exposed.

activation_trace.role: A split cloth piece supplies the torn-canopy material.
The overhead covering functions as the canopy's outer face.
Rose color supplies the newly exposed inner face.
Oily coating gives the exposed lining its sheen.
Thin sheets and plates supply a layered surface model.
Garment lining supplies the hidden inner layer revealed by splitting.
A hanging or fluttering cover extends the canopy analogy.
Fine patterned rugs supply the richly visible textile finish.

structural_cues: 55:54 explicitly contrasts furnishings with their inner linings, and 55:76 returns to hanging green material and patterned fabric.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies layered furnishings, linings, and covers; I infer that these later materials reveal what the focus's cloth branch can do to the sky; alternatively, the garden textiles may not project backward onto cosmic structure.

changed_reading.before: The sky is a generic solid shell with a red exterior.
changed_reading.after: The sky can be a layered canopy whose tear turns its rose-colored, oil-sheened inner lining outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Coral luster, dark saturation, persistent staining, and intense greenness form a later palette of material states. The focus rose-oil color becomes one diagnostic state within that palette, not generic decoration or a single undifferentiated red.

activation_trace.role: A sign read as evidence of condition makes color classificatory.
Rose-tinted color supplies the focus state's precise chromatic class.
Coral between pearl and bead supplies a contrasting red, hard, lustrous material.
Dark black saturation supplies another state identified by dense color.
A splash that leaves a trace links fluid action to persistent visible marking.
Green that can deepen toward black supplies a calibrated chromatic opposite to rose.

structural_cues: 55:58, 55:64, and 55:76 repeatedly identify objects and environments through luster, dark saturation, and green color.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of sharply materialized colors and stains; I infer that hue classifies condition across the surah; alternatively, each comparison may remain locally aesthetic without forming a shared code.

changed_reading.before: Rose is an interchangeable word for apocalyptic redness.
changed_reading.after: Rose-oil is one exact material-color state in a wider diagnostic palette of luster, darkness, staining, and greenness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same source root that names the physical sky later names a raised designation, while blessing supplies stable growing good. The split of material height can therefore coexist with, and sharpen, the persistence of semantic elevation in the closing Name.

activation_trace.role: The physical overhead sky supplies elevation that can lose its material form.
Splitting terminates the integrity of physical height.
Name as raised designation relocates elevation from material cover to enduring mention.
Stable growing good gives the raised designation continuity after cosmic alteration.

structural_cues: The closing 55:78 Name follows the split sky and repeats the branchless ج ل ل cue from 55:27; that missing inventory is used only as sequence framing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root spanning sky and raised designation, followed by stable blessing; I infer a transfer from physical to semantic elevation; alternatively, the shared root may be ordinary etymological proximity without a deliberate closing reversal.

changed_reading.before: When the elevated sky splits, elevation itself collapses.
changed_reading.after: Material elevation is dismantled, while elevation as named and blessed designation remains active at the close.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the sky as quasi-organic; it remains anchored in the physical fissure, overhead cover, life-bearing neck-vein branch, and oily smear; render only as a cross-domain material analogy, not as a claim that the verse literally anatomizes the sky.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The arrival root's vein branch can combine with splitting and oil to make the rose line look like exposed living tissue.

activation_trace.role: A physical fissure supplies the wound-like opening.
The upper covering supplies a skin-like surface for the analogy.
The life-bearing neck vein supplies a red internal line exposed at the fissure.

changed_reading.before: The sky is inert scenery colored red.
changed_reading.after: The sky can be imagined as a wounded membrane whose fissure exposes a vein-like, glossy red interior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because two non-dominant split mappings turn a visual event into nasal and atmospheric sensation; it remains valid as an activation because every step is focus-anchored and the rose and oil supply a sensory medium; render as synesthetic possibility, never as the primary lexical parse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Non-dominant mappings activate smelling wind through the nose and a penetrating hot wind at the exact words for splitting and sky.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it translates cosmic material into social mechanism; it remains anchored in conflictual splitting, high order, successive groups, and dissembling softness; render as a secondary political-social analogy and keep the literal cosmic reading alongside it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Conflict, elevated order, advancing groups, and conciliatory dissembling coexist in the focus inventories.

activation_trace.role: A group splitting in conflict supplies social rupture.

Groups pressing forward successively supply the emergent opposing fronts.
Conciliatory softening and dissembling supply the smooth veneer that rupture exposes.

changed_reading.before: Only a physical upper surface loses cohesion.
changed_reading.after: An elevated order's smooth conciliatory veneer splits, revealing successive adversarial fronts beneath it.

strongest_changes: The raised and measured sky becomes an installed architecture being deliberately unmade, not an isolated weather spectacle.
The attempted passage, molten-copper activation, flame, and red metal reverse an apparent opening into a hot sealing scar at a defended boundary.
The shared mapped marking branch between the focus sky and the later visible signs turns rose-oil color into actionable self-identification.
Fluid, thermal, paired, textile, and chromatic mechanisms remain live together rather than being merged into one literalized picture.
summary.what_was_special: Split-root inventories made the focus unusually generative: sky also activated marking and aperture, splitting also activated counterpart cloth and sensory inhalation, rose also activated arrival, fever, and vein, and oil also activated coating, route, and social veneer. Context converted several of these odd branches into coherent changed readings without forcing a single winner.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the oil comparison primarily selects liquid viscosity, glossy coating, molten material, or smooth surface remains open.
Whether the rose term is functioning chiefly as blossom-shape, hue, arrival, timed fever, or a deliberate superposition cannot be settled from the packet.
The kiln, interface, defensive-seal, textile, and color-code arrows are abductive constructions; context supplies their elements but not an explicit causal direction.
Non-dominant mapped roots are retained as activators and should not be mistaken for claims about the focus words' primary morphology.
